messages:
morgan: quick idea — add a 'Create routing exemption' button in Console next to route pins so CSMs can self-serve short-lived overrides for enterprise customers. thoughts?

sasha: love the self-serve angle, but we need audit + strict TTL defaults. last thing we want is permanent shunts. :grimacing:

priya: +1. UI should require: reason, requested-by, TTL dropdown (15m / 1h / 8h / 24h), and an optional approver field. show a clear history entry and who revoked it. also expose an API so automation can create them.

joel: from the gateway side we need: an ephemeral exemption token, header-based enforcement (eg x-rw-exempt: <id,hmac>), and provenance metadata in logs. also need a fast revoke path that propagates to edge caches.

morgan: example CLI we talked about earlier:
```
redwoodctl routing exempt --org acme-corp --route /v1/chat --ttl 1h --reason "prod demo" --actor morgan
```
that would return an exemption id and a signed header value to use if doing a bypass.

devops-bot: audit: exemption-created id=ex_20231109_82 by=morgan origin=console ttl=3600 route=/v1/chat

sasha: telemetry: capture origin (console/ui/cli), actor_id, exemption_id, route_fingerprint, and change_trace_id so we can tie to traces. also emit metric exemptions.active_by_org and exemptions.revoked_latency_ms.

security-bot: policy note: anything >24h must require a second approver or security review. disallow exemptions that alter auth headers or bypass encryption. HMAC keys for the header must be rotated and stored in KMS.

priya: rollout plan: feature-flag the UI, enable for CSM+SE teams first, run for 2 weeks, then open to SOC-approved customers. add an admin console view showing active exemptions and a revoke button.

joel: one more: what about quotas / burst shaping? exempting route could still allow customers to blow past their quota. should we enforce soft-limits or require an explicit quota override step?

morgan: good point — propose two types: routing-exempt (only routing change) and routing-exempt+quota-bump (requires billing & finance signoff). keep the UI separate and show required approvals.

priya: i'll draft the UX mocks and API contract. assign me the ticket if folks are ok.

morgan: sounds good. action items: priya -> mocks + API spec; joel -> gateway HMAC + revoke impl; sasha -> telemetry/metrics; security-bot -> formal policy for >24h exemptions. sync tomorrow 11:00am. :thumbsup:
